rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The statement 内閣総理大臣談話, dated 26 December 2012 and marked 閣議決定 (the page heading is dated 27 December 2012), says that the speaker had that day again received appointment as Prime Minister (本日、私は再び内閣総理大臣を拝命し) and that a new LDP-Komeito coalition cabinet had been launched; it refers to the cabinet as 安倍内閣.
